concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 (diffusion‑length estimation) is not addressed by any task in tasks.md; the pipeline will never produce the required `diffusion_lengths.csv` or include diffusion length as a predictor, violating the specification.

Functional Requirement FR-010 (linearity diagnostic before reporting Pearson results) is absent from the task list; no task creates or verifies a residual‑analysis / lack‑of‑fit test, leaving the requirement unmet.

The amendment to FR-001 that mandates a descriptive preliminary report when fewer than 10 usable samples are available is not mapped to any concrete task; the plan lacks a fallback branch to generate such a report.

Success‑rate threshold (≥ 95 %) from Success Criterion SC‑004 is not enforced in the verification steps of T002; the task only checks schema validation and non‑null performance fields, leaving the quantitative requirement unchecked.
